paragraphs.text: School visits run from Tuesday to Friday and must be booked four weeks ahead. A visit lasts 90 minutes and includes the mill floor, where a machine from 1889 is started twice a day, at 11 am and 2 pm.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Groups of up to 30 pupils pay £45; larger groups are divided in two. Lunch may be eaten in the courtyard or, in bad weather, in the education room, which holds 40 people.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: must be booked four weeks ahead
items.prompt: How far ahead must a school visit be booked?

explanation.kk: «booked four weeks ahead» → four weeks. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
explanation.ru: «booked four weeks ahead» → four weeks. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.

items.prompt: How long does a visit last?

explanation.kk: «A visit lasts 90 minutes» → 90 minutes. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
explanation.ru: «A visit lasts 90 minutes» → 90 minutes. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.

items.quote: where a machine from 1889 is started twice a day
items.prompt: In which year was the mill machine made?

explanation.en: “a machine from 1889” → 1889. 11 am and 2 pm are the starting times.
explanation.kk: «a machine from 1889» → 1889. 11 am мен 2 pm — қосу уақыты.
explanation.ru: «a machine from 1889» → 1889. 11 am и 2 pm — время запуска.
